changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the Terrestrial and Wireless Networks segment was rebranded to Allerium.
changes.evidence: During fiscal 2025, we launched the rebranding of our Terrestrial and Wireless Networks segment to "Allerium," a fusion of "all" and "continuum."

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Satellite and Space Communications segment was classified as discontinued operations pending sale to Wavestream Corporation.
changes.evidence: As the Strategic Transaction represents a material strategic shift in our business, the results and net assets of the Disposal Group are presented herein as "discontinued operations" and comparable prior periods have been recast to reflect this change.
